children: Forgent Power Solutions Inc. (FPS) filed a Form 8K - Operations and Financial Condition - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 15, 2026.
On September 15, 2026, Forgent Power Solutions, Inc. issued a press release announcing its financial results for its fiscal year ended June 30, 2026.

A copy of such press release is attached hereto as Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated herein by reference. A reconciliation of certain non-GAAP financial measures to their comparable GAAP financial measures is contained in the press release.

This information shall not be deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"), or incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act, except as shall be expressly set forth by specific reference in such a filing.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2080126/000208012626000034/fps-20260915.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2080126/000208012626000034/0002080126-26-000034-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
